entities.name: Shisato
entities.description: An orochi renegade known for cunning and ruthlessness whose venom could kill another orochi; she hunted Dosan's monks.

entities.name: Kashi tribe
entities.description: Orochi tribe whose rituals Shisato could not join; led by Sosuke.

entities.name: Sosuke
entities.description: Leader of the Kashi tribe who acknowledged Shisato as a skilled hunter and killer.

entities.name: Jukai Forest
entities.description: Forest whose human monks Shisato hunted.

entities.name: Orochi
entities.description: Snake-like people divided into tribes and castes.

events.summary: Shisato kills her opponent in ritual combat instead of merely besting him, touching off a chain of vendettas.
events.quote: when she killed her opponent instead of just besting him, she touched off a chain of vendettas

events.summary: Four orochi warriors fight Shisato to avenge their kin, and she slays all four.
events.quote: Four orochi warriors fought her to avenge their fallen kin, and Shisato slew all four

events.summary: Feared and distrusted by the orochi, Shisato grows bitter, ventures from the colonies and begins hunting the Jukai Forest's human monks.
events.quote: Eventually, she began to hunt bigger prey: the Jukai Forest’s human monks

relations.quote: its leader Sosuke acknowledged that she was a skilled hunter and killer
